title: Motif recipe
description: One 3-event acoustic motif recipe (renderer spec 0.1.0, pilot default; freezes at G4). The profile is passed to the renderer separately. Every field is an enum so the schema can be used for constrained decoding unchanged. Checks a schema cannot express (60 ms events, clipping, duplicates, reserved signals, separation) belong to the validator.

total_ms.description: Motif length in milliseconds, including both gaps.

pitches.description: Semitone offset of each event from the profile base frequency.

rhythm_weights.description: Relative share of (total_ms - gaps) given to each event.

gaps_ms.description: Silence after event 1 and after event 2, in milliseconds.
